header.title: GROUP STRUCTURE & GLOBAL ECOSYSTEM
header.headline: One Group, Two Commercial Lines, One Social Mandate.
header.subheadline: Bishnoi Omniverse is the healthcare infrastructure and hospital supply business within the wider Bishnoi Group, which also includes the Getmeds pharmaceutical access network and the Naresh Bishnoi Foundation's philanthropic initiatives.

vision.title: How the group is organised
vision.lead: Two commercial businesses supply healthcare providers. One philanthropic arm answers to a different mandate entirely. We keep them clearly separated so partners always know which entity they are dealing with.
vision.paragraph: Bishnoi Omniverse supplies hospitals, clinics, and trade partners with hospital-grade medical supplies and hard-to-source specialty medicines through hubs in India and the Philippines. The Getmeds network extends pharmaceutical access across the Philippines, India, the Pacific, Latin America, and Southeast Asia. Alongside them, the Naresh Bishnoi Foundation and our UN Global Compact participation carry the group's social and environmental commitments.

sections.title: Bishnoi Omniverse — Hospital Supply & Healthcare Infrastructure
sections.description: Bishnoi Omniverse supplies hospitals, clinics, and trade partners with medical-surgical consumables and facility infrastructure, sourced directly from certified manufacturers and documented for procurement and regulatory review.

bullets.name: Bishnoi Omniverse LLP (India):
bullets.desc: Sourcing hub in New Delhi — direct manufacturer sourcing, product qualification, and documentation assembly.

bullets.name: Bishnoi Omniverse Corp (Philippines):
bullets.desc: Asia-Pacific logistics and operations hub in Metro Manila, tied to Getmeds Philippines Inc. / 2MG Inc., handling regional consolidation and cold-chain movement.

bullets.name: Core Lines:
bullets.desc: IV and infusion therapy, blood bank and transfusion products, surgical connectivity, airway management, and medical gas.

sections.title: The Getmeds Network — Pharmaceutical Access & Specialty Care
sections.tagline: Cross-border access to medicines that aren't yet available locally.
sections.description: The Getmeds network provides named-patient and cross-border access to oncology therapies, rare biosimilars, and critical-care medicines, sourced from verified manufacturers and documented for regulatory review in the destination market.

bullets.name: Getmeds Philippines:
bullets.desc: Everyday essential medicines and healthcare services across the Philippine archipelago.

bullets.name: Getmeds Healthcare (India):
bullets.desc: Pharmaceutical export engine enabling named-patient access to specialised oncology and critical-care therapies, including the Carboget™ carboplatin injection from WHO-GMP certified manufacturing.

bullets.name: Getmeds Vanuatu:
bullets.desc: Specialty pharmacy presence in the Pacific region, providing local access to cancer treatments.

bullets.name: Getmeds Latin America:
bullets.desc: Cross-border distribution partnerships across Latin American markets.

bullets.name: Getmeds Southeast Asia:
bullets.desc: Regional supply lines across emerging Southeast Asian territories.

sections.title: Social Impact, Stewardship & Sustainability
sections.tagline: A separate mandate, run alongside the commercial businesses — not through them.
sections.description: The group's philanthropic and sustainability work is held separately from its supply businesses, so neither is used to speak for the other.

bullets.name: Naresh Bishnoi Foundation (NBF):
bullets.desc: Philanthropic initiatives across education, agricultural innovation, youth empowerment, and cultural preservation.

bullets.name: NKB.COM (Family Office & Initiatives):
bullets.desc: The platform representing the wider investments and future ventures of Naresh Kumar Bishnoi.

bullets.name: United Nations Global Compact:
bullets.desc: Active Participant since November 2024, with Communications on Progress filed for 2025 and 2026, and leadership representation at the UNGC Forward Faster Now | APAC Conference 2026 in Colombo, Sri Lanka (11–12 August 2026).

legacy.title: Independent divisions, one standard of accountability
legacy.description: Every division runs independently with its own specialised focus and its own regulatory obligations. What they share is a single standard: document what you supply, and say plainly what you cannot.
legacy.footerBrand: Bishnoi Omniverse | Part of the Bishnoi Group
